# Turn an axe scan into a Title II evidence record.

> Turn a government website's axe-core JSON scan into a dated WCAG 2.1 AA evidence record for ADA Title II, split into required findings and best-practice extras. Runs locally in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/ada-title-ii-evidence/)
- [Which ADA Title II website deadline applies to you?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/ada-title-ii-evidence/deadline.html)
- [This evidence report vs. accessiBe](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/ada-title-ii-evidence/vs-accessibe.html)
